npcCollision.rule: Block destination tile if it overlaps active NPC 32x32 sprite footprint. Non-grid-aligned x/y include both floor and ceil tile positions. Party slots0..7 are not checked by routine0x7AF6.

touchAdaptation.movement: Four-neighbor path over values0..79; apply bounds and dynamic NPC footprints
touchAdaptation.npcInteraction: Path to a walkable cardinal neighbor of actor; face actor; invoke original NPC interaction rather than enter actor tile
touchAdaptation.objectInteraction: For raw128..175 path to a cardinal walkable neighbor and invoke explicit interaction
touchAdaptation.eventTiles: Values1..79 can be walked on and trigger scripts; do not erase or normalize these codes
touchAdaptation.exitUi: Every inventory/shop/dialogue overlay must expose close or cancel; this is requested HTML5 behavior, not inferred ROM control mapping
